[LLEX.10.7.1] **The lexer has no pattern-position mode.** `*` is
unconditionally the multiplication operator and `.<name>` is unconditionally slot
access, so the token stream is context-free — no lexing decision depends on
parser state. An adapter entity is matched by a `where` regex over its identity
slot (`where entity_id ~ /…/`), which needs no lexical mode
([LADP.2]).
